correctness.rationale: For each edge-pair atom, conditioning produces two uniform interval variables. The affine determinant is |det(e_i,e_j)|/4 for nonparallel sides; its density integrates to 2 li lj/P^2. Rank-one cases push to same-edge triangular densities (weight li^2/P^2) or distinct-parallel triangular/trapezoidal overlap densities (weight 2 li lj/P^2). These are mutually singular relative to planar area; the convexity argument locates same-edge mass on the boundary and parallel-pair mass strictly inside it. All edge-pair events partition total probability. The regular-n parity and centrally symmetric Cauchy--Schwarz equality follow from exact pair counts. The attached standalone code passed normalization and supplementary sampling checks.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural probability-measure classification for all nondegenerate convex polygons, not a selected coefficient. It gives exact densities and singular supports, shows that a positive interior line-mass is equivalent to a pair of parallel polygon edges, yields an explicit strong parity contrast 1/n versus 2/n for regular n-gons, and proves a sharp centrally symmetric singular-mass bound with complete equality cases. The result is a reproducible benchmark for geometric probability under boundary-endpoint sampling and quantifies a qualitative distinction from smooth-body midpoint laws.
